sources.title: MTP Module and Draft Vocabulary Preparation | syv-ai/qwen38-27b-rtx3090 ...
sources.snippet: This section covers the preparation of the Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) speculative decoding infrastructure. In the qwen3.8-27b architecture, MTP acts as a native drafter that predicts multiple future tokens in a single forward pass. This page details the requantization of the MTP module, the construction of an optimized draft vocabulary for low-latency scoring, and the vLLM integration that ...

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 · Models
sources.snippet: We compare autoregressive decoding, Qwen3.8's built-in seven-token MTP, a community DSpark drafter (RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark), and DFlash 2. All speculative methods propose seven draft tokens per verification step. Acceptance Length Acceptance length is the per-request mean of completion tokens divided by verification steps. Higher is better.
